Style over Substance. Frustratingly.

Below average food but nice location
Dec 2019 • Family
Had lunch here with the family as it is close to Tran Quoc Pagoda. The restaurant was air conditioned and had comfortable western style tables and chairs with a great view. Seemed very well presented from the outside, little cakes and desserts looked amazing. We had some savoury items - the BBQ chicken croquette, pastry with a sausage in it; and some sweet things - croissant, french toast & a bun with condensed milk cream. Everything tasted sweet though, including the savoury items. The condensed milk cream bun was the tastiest. Very pricey for what we got and the quality of it. Had a better croissant at our hotel breakfast buffet. The ladies toilet was broken and was told to use the male toilet..which was pretty foul. Not the worst I’ve seen or smelt but definitely made me think twice about the cleanliness of the place and the meal I had just had.

Cheeseless shame
Nov 2019 • Couples
Ordered several items from the menu and buffet. This included the 'Cheesy Fries'(with cheese, nacho sauce and ranch) which were priced at 160'000 VD. For this extortion, I expected a bowl of messy, cheesy, greasy goodness. Instead, and as can be seen in the picture, I received some plain, lukewarm dry fries that appear to have had a used cheese grater shaken over the top of half of the dish. These few slithers of old plastic 'cheese' did not contain the sweet calories nor the necessary sustenance my body was craving after my 10km trek around the sites of Hanoi. I always like to give staff a second chance, so I showed a member of staff the dish, expecting him to share my lack of enthusiasm. After a brief shout with the kitchen staff, he told me that this was all I was getting. I asked for salt, to aid the journey of the tasteless yellow fries on the palate, but was told they didn't have any, and that I had been given sauce already, so I wasn't getting any of that either. Disappointment with a pathetic sprinkling of shame doesn't cover how I felt when I left. Needless to say - I won't be returning.

Real Cool Parisian style Cafe
Jun 2019 • Family
Vietnam has surprised me with some real nice Cafe’s, one better than the last one. I found this real cool place next to “West Lake”.

Excellent Coffee & Pastries. The coffee is indeed very good and a huge relief for some one like me who just can’t take Vietnamese coffee. We tried some Golden Berry Tart & Hot Cheese Cake. 
Surprisingly prices for such a chic place is very reasonable.. just about VND 170k for all of this. 
Must visit place. It’s right next to “Tran Quoc Pagoda”.

Study/snack space
Mar 2016 • Friends
It is a branch from Korea and many located in other areas around the world.

The space is large enough to always have seats, so many people go in and out. The food is mostly baked goods but there are also salads, sandwiches, and even thai salads. The food is a bit pricey compared to normal vietnamese foods/cafes nearby. The drinks are delicious though.

The staff is so nice. One time, I left my umbrella, and they kept it for me when I returned. They were super kind about it too. They also don't mind the length of your stay. The music can be very random at times, sometimes Korean sometimes English, but maybe depends on the staff.
